snake-io.title: Snake.io: Online Multiplayer Snake Battle Game
snake-io.slogan: Fight, Grow, and Dominate in Snake.io
snake-io.description: Snake.io is an exciting online multiplayer game where you control a snake in a battle for survival. Eat colorful food to grow larger and defeat other snakes to become the ultimate champion. With simple controls and competitive gameplay, Snake.io offers endless fun for players of all ages. Join the action-packed arena of Snake.io and see if you can rise to the top!

HomeIframe.title: Snake.io
HomeIframe.description: Experience the thrill of Snake.io, an online multiplayer game where you battle other snakes to grow and dominate. Eat food, avoid obstacles, and become the largest snake in the arena. Play Snake.io now and join the fun!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Snake.io is an online multiplayer game where you control a snake in a battle for survival. Eat food to grow larger and defeat other snakes to become the ultimate champion.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Move your snake using the arrow keys or swipe gestures.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Eat colorful food to grow larger and increase your score.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Avoid collisions with other snakes and the arena walls to survive.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Compete against players from around the world in real-time.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Easy-to-learn controls make Snake.io accessible for all players.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: With no end to the game, you can keep playing and improving your skills.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Enjoy vibrant and engaging visuals as you play Snake.io.
